newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS ground staff to strike from March 7.
newsitem.headline: SAS ground staff to strike from March 7.

text.p: Administrative staff at Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) are to go on strike from March 7 to support a pay claim, their union said in a statement on Wednesday.

Nicolas Fischer, leader of the LFF aviation staff union, told Reuters that the dispute was more about employment conditions than money with his union demanding a 3.25 percent pay rise in return for meeting SAS demands for more flexible working practices.
"But they wanted to squeeze us a little bit more...their offer to us was 3.0 percent, but then they wanted a lot of flexibility," he said.
He added that passenger check-in and cargo-handling staff would stop work on March 7 and sales and back-office personnel would halt on March 10, both for an unlimited period.
